subject: Multi-region demo: compact slot options and follow-up plan
messages:
From: Emily Rhodes <emily@saturnanalytics.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@saturnanalytics.com
Date: Mon, 11 May 2026 13:00:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Demo request — best times this week?

Hi Priya,

Thanks for the quick outreach. We're excited to see Redwood in action. A couple of constraints on our side:
- We're US East (ET) — prefer demos between 11:00 AM and 3:00 PM ET.
- Avoid 9:00–10:00 AM ET on Thursday (company all-hands).
- Our engineering leads are limited to 30–45 minute slots for vendor evals; we can extend for deep dives but would prefer a compact exec-friendly demo first.

Can your team accommodate a compact 30-minute walkthrough that still lets us judge latency/cost tradeoffs? If so, please propose 2–3 concrete slot times and indicate how long an engineering follow-up would be.

CC'ing procurement for calendar/PO visibility.

Thanks,
Emily
Emily Rhodes
Head of Product
Saturn Analytics

From: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.com>
To: Emily Rhodes <emily@saturnanalytics.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, procurement@saturnanalytics.com
Date: Mon, 11 May 2026 19:05:00 +0100
Subject: Re: Demo request — best times this week?

Hi Emily — great to meet you (virtually). Thanks for those constraints; we can absolutely do a compact session. Quick context so the slots make sense: our EU SRE and product SMEs are in CEST (UTC+2) and prefer not to start much past 19:30 CEST on weekdays, otherwise we need to pull on-call rotation. With DST differences this month that often trips customers, so I’ll list times in both ET and CEST.

Proposed compact (30–40 min) slots — all include a focused product walkthrough and a short Q&A:
- Option A: Thursday 11 May — 10:00 AM ET / 16:00 CEST (30 min)
- Option B: Thursday 11 May — 1:00 PM ET / 19:00 CEST (40 min)

If you prefer an extended engineering session (60–90 min) we can schedule a follow-up within 48 hours; our engineers can join for the longer deep-dive. I attached a 30-min agenda and an .ics stub to make calendar booking easier.

Files attached: redwood-30min-mvp-agenda.pdf, saturn-demo-slots-compact.ics

If those are tight, Karthik can propose a pair of alternative windows. Let me know which you want and I'll send the invite with an attendee list.

Best,
Priya Natarajan
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference

From: Emily Rhodes <emily@saturnanalytics.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@saturnanalytics.com
Date: Mon, 11 May 2026 13:42:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Demo request — best times this week?

Thanks Priya — quick clarification: Thursday this week would be 11 May (yes). Our engineering lead says they can't do before 11:00 AM ET on that day; 13:00 ET would be ideal if your team can make it. Also — could you confirm whether 19:00 CEST means your engineers would be working late? We want to avoid pushing folks into after-hours where possible.

If 13:00 ET / 19:00 CEST is workable we can do the compact slot and then schedule a separate 60-min technical Q&A for early next week.

Emily

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Emily Rhodes <emily@saturnanalytics.com>, Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, procurement@saturnanalytics.com
Date: Mon, 11 May 2026 19:56:00 +0100
Subject: Re: Demo request — best times this week?

Hi Emily — looping in to offer a couple more tight options and clear up the DST labeling (we know CET vs CEST causes confusion around late spring). Our engineers are happy to support one late slot this week but prefer to keep it under 45 minutes. Concrete options: 
- Slot 1 (earlier): Thursday 11 May — 09:30 AM ET / 15:30 CEST (30–35 min)
- Slot 2 (later, matches Emily's ask): Thursday 11 May — 01:00 PM ET / 19:00 CEST (40 min)

Note: CEST (UTC+2) is in effect; the CEST times above reflect that. If you prefer, we can list everything in UTC to remove ambiguity (I can do that on the calendar invite).

Shared scheduling helper: https://time.redwood.com/convert?tz=ET-CEST

If Thursday 13:00 ET is the consensus, we'll confirm and Priya will send a calendar invite with the short agenda and attendee list.

Thanks,
Karthik
Principal Solutions Architect | Redwood Inference

From: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.com>
To: Emily Rhodes <emily@saturnanalytics.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, procurement@saturnanalytics.com
Date: Tue, 12 May 2026 00:12:00 +0100
Subject: Re: Demo request — best times this week?

Emily/Karthik — thanks both. We can confirm Option B: Thursday 11 May, 01:00 PM ET / 19:00 CEST as the compact exec demo (40 minutes). Engineers will be available; it's within our late-window tolerance for this prep session. We'll keep the demo tight and demo the low-latency serving paths and cost controls so your engineering lead can judge fit quickly.

Action items I'll take:
- Send calendar invite for Thu 11 May 13:00 ET / 19:00 CEST (attached .ics).
- Add a follow-up 90-minute engineering slot for Mon 15 May (proposed times to follow).
- Include a short attendee list and meeting recording enabled.

Attendees (provisional):
- From Saturn: Emily Rhodes, (engineering lead TBD), procurement liaison
- From Redwood: Priya Natarajan (SE), Karthik Iyer (Architect), Marissa Cole (Customer Success)

I'll pull the attendee names into the invite and share the MAP (mutual action plan) link after you confirm.

Best,
Priya

See you Thursday.

Emily
